summary: Emit canonical agent identities in mission presentation and admit canonical mission work actors

replay.detail: Historical rows remain unchanged; presentation canonicalizes legacy slash-qualified agent identities on read.

schema.detail: The strict client AgentId schema and database schema are unchanged.

rules.detail: Mission assignees, run-start actors and work actions canonicalize slash-qualified agent identities. Work eligibility compares canonical identities and malformed work actors are rejected.

compatibility.detail: Legacy unprefixed assignees and claimants resolve canonical roster seats and emit agent-prefixed presentation identities, so strict clients retain mission rows.

downtime.detail: No data migration or coordinated client rollout is required.

recovery.detail: Existing transaction rollback and lease fencing remain unchanged.
